comments.text: Kitty's brother actually made a documentary about her death that somewhat disproves the whole "bystander effect" theory. It's called The Witness if anyone wants to check it out! I learnt about Kitty in college when I was studying Psychology and believed the idea that people witnessed her being attacked and did nothing, leaving her to die alone. After watching the documentary, I was relieved to know that she at least died in the arms of her friend who lived close by.
